skills.title: Test a factor with the Factor Theorem
skills.io: polynomial f(x) and (x − a) → f(a) = 0 ⇒ factor
skills.example: f(x) = x³ − 7x + 6, f(1) = 0 → (x − 1) is a factor

skills.title: Find an integer root by trial
skills.io: cubic with integer coefficients → integer root (divisor of constant)

skills.title: Solve a cubic with at least one integer root
skills.io: cubic equation → all roots

skills.title: Find unknown coefficients from given factors
skills.io: polynomial with unknowns + factor(s) → unknown values
skills.example: (x − 2) is a factor of x³ + kx² − 4x + 12 → k = −3

skills.title: Form a cubic from its roots
skills.io: three roots → cubic equation

skills.title: Evaluate an expression
skills.io: expression + values of variables → number

skills.title: Collect like terms
skills.io: expression → simplified expression

skills.title: Expand a bracket by a term
skills.io: a(bx ± cy ± d) → expanded expression

skills.title: Multiply out two brackets
skills.io: (x ± y)(w ± z) → expanded, simplified expression

skills.title: Add/subtract linear and quadratic expressions
skills.io: (ax²+bx+c) ± (dx²+ex+f) → simplified expression

skills.title: Factorise by highest common factor
skills.io: expression → factor × bracket

skills.title: Factorise by grouping
skills.io: four-term expression → product of two brackets
skills.example: ax + ay + bx + by → (a + b)(x + y)

skills.title: Factorise a difference of two squares
skills.io: a² − b² → (a − b)(a + b)

skills.title: Factorise a quadratic trinomial
skills.io: ax² + bx + c → (px + q)(rx + s)

skills.title: Factorise a sum/difference of two cubes
skills.io: a³ ± b³ → (a ± b)(a² ∓ ab + b²)

skills.title: Add/subtract algebraic fractions
skills.io: a/(bx+c) ± p/(qx+r) → single fraction

skills.title: Multiply, divide and simplify rational expressions
skills.io: rational algebraic expressions → simplified fraction

skills.title: Multiply polynomials
skills.io: two polynomials → expanded polynomial

skills.title: Divide a polynomial by a linear or quadratic
skills.io: dividend, divisor → quotient (and remainder)

skills.title: Simplify algebraic expressions with surds
skills.io: expression with surds and brackets → simplified / rationalised form

skills.title: Rearrange a formula
skills.io: formula + new subject → subject = expression

skills.title: Equate coefficients of identical polynomials
skills.io: identity with unknown constants → values of the constants

skills.title: Expand with the binomial theorem
skills.io: (a + b)ⁿ, n ∈ N → full expansion

skills.title: Find a given term/coefficient of a binomial expansion
skills.io: (a + b)ⁿ + required power → general term Tᵣ₊₁ and its value

skills.title: Solve a linear inequality
skills.io: ax + b ≤ k (and <, >, ≥), domain N/Z/R → solution set on number line

skills.title: Solve a combined (double) linear inequality
skills.io: k₁ ≤ ax + b < k₂ → interval

skills.title: Solve a quadratic inequality
skills.io: ax² + bx + c ≤ k → interval(s)

skills.title: Solve a rational inequality
skills.io: (ax + b)/(cx + d) ≤ k → interval(s), excluding x = −d/c

skills.title: Solve modulus inequalities
skills.io: |x − a| < b, |x − a| > b and combinations → interval(s)

skills.title: Prove an algebraic inequality
skills.io: inequality in a, b → proof via a square ≥ 0

skills.title: Solve a quadratic by factorising
skills.io: ax² + bx + c = 0 → roots

skills.title: Solve a quadratic with the formula
skills.io: ax² + bx + c = k (not necessarily factorisable) → exact (surd) or decimal roots

skills.title: Form a quadratic from its roots
skills.io: two whole-number roots → ax² + bx + c = 0

skills.title: Use b² − 4ac for the nature of roots
skills.io: quadratic (possibly with a parameter) → real/equal/complex roots; parameter value
skills.example: x² + kx + 9 = 0 has equal roots → k = ±6

skills.title: Express a quadratic in completed-square form
skills.io: ax² + bx + c → a(x + p)² + q

skills.title: Use completed-square form for roots and turning point
skills.io: a(x + p)² + q → roots, turning point, sketch

skills.title: Solve two linear equations in two unknowns
skills.io: two linear equations → (x, y)

skills.title: Solve one linear and one order-2 equation
skills.io: linear (coefficient ±1) + quadratic → intersection points

skills.title: Solve linear + order-2 with any coefficients
skills.io: linear + quadratic in x, y → intersection points

skills.title: Solve three linear equations in three unknowns
skills.io: three linear equations → (x, y, z)

skills.title: Form simultaneous equations from a context
skills.io: verbal problem → equations, solution, interpretation

skills.title: Solve a linear equation
skills.io: ax + b = cx + d → x

skills.title: Solve a linear equation with fractions
skills.io: equation with numeric denominators → x

skills.title: Solve a/(bx+c) ± p/(qx+r) = e/f
skills.io: equation with algebraic denominators → x (check denominators ≠ 0)

skills.title: Solve (ax+b)/(ex+f) ± (cx+d)/(qx+r) = k
skills.io: equation with algebraic numerators and denominators → x

skills.title: Solve an equation involving a square root
skills.io: √(f(x)) = g(x) → x, extraneous roots rejected

skills.title: Form and solve an equation from a context
skills.io: verbal problem → equation, solution, interpretation
skills.example: width x, length x+3, area 40 → x = 5

skills.title: Find perimeter and area of plane figures
skills.io: disc, triangle, rectangle, square, parallelogram, trapezium, sector, combinations → perimeter, area

skills.title: Draw and interpret nets of prisms, cylinders and cones
skills.io: solid → net and its dimensions

skills.title: Find surface area of solids
skills.io: block, cylinder, cone, triangular prism, sphere, hemisphere → surface area
skills.example: cone r = 3, h = 4 → l = 5, curved SA 15π

skills.title: Find volume of solids
skills.io: block, cylinder, cone, triangular prism, sphere, hemisphere → volume

skills.title: Find area/volume of compound solids
skills.io: solid made of several shapes → total surface area/volume

skills.title: Solve recasting, displacement and flow problems
skills.io: equal-volume situation → unknown dimension or time
skills.example: sphere r = 3 recast as cylinder r = 2 → h = 9

skills.title: Approximate area with the trapezoidal rule
skills.io: strip width h, heights y₁…yₙ → h/2[(y₁ + yₙ) + 2(y₂ + … + yₙ₋₁)]

skills.title: Apply order of operations
skills.io: numerical expression with brackets/powers → single value

skills.title: Operate on fractions
skills.io: fractions/mixed numbers → simplified fraction

skills.title: Use ratio and direct/inverse proportion
skills.io: quantities in proportion → divided shares or unknown quantity

skills.title: Classify numbers into N, Z, Q, R, C
skills.io: a number → its smallest set; place on number line

skills.title: Convert decimals and fractions
skills.io: terminating/recurring decimal or fraction → equivalent form

skills.title: Express a number as a product of primes
skills.io: natural number → prime factorisation; HCF/LCM

skills.title: Simplify and operate on surds
skills.io: surd expression → simplified surd, rational denominator

skills.title: Work in scientific notation
skills.io: numbers in a×10ⁿ form → result in a×10ⁿ, 1 ≤ a < 10

skills.title: Add, subtract and multiply complex numbers
skills.io: a + bi, c + di → result in a + bi form

skills.title: Simplify powers of i
skills.io: iⁿ → 1, i, −1 or −i

skills.title: Find the conjugate
skills.io: z = a + bi → z̄ = a − bi

skills.title: Divide complex numbers
skills.io: z₁ / z₂ → a + bi via conjugate of denominator

skills.title: Plot complex numbers on an Argand diagram
skills.io: z → point (Re, Im)

skills.title: Find the modulus as distance from the origin
skills.io: z = a + bi → |z| = √(a² + b²)

skills.title: Equate real and imaginary parts
skills.io: equation in complex numbers with unknowns → values of unknowns

skills.title: Interpret operations as transformations on the Argand diagram
skills.io: z and an operation (+w, ×i, ×k) → translation / rotation / enlargement

skills.title: Use conjugates of sums and products
skills.io: z₁, z₂ → conj(z₁ + z₂) = z̄₁ + z̄₂, conj(z₁z₂) = z̄₁z̄₂

skills.title: Solve a quadratic with complex roots
skills.io: quadratic with b² − 4ac < 0 → conjugate pair of roots

skills.title: Use the Conjugate Root Theorem to find all roots
skills.io: real polynomial + one complex root → all roots
skills.example: 1 + i is a root of z³ − 4z² + 6z − 4 → 1 ± i, 2

skills.title: Convert between rectangular and polar form
skills.io: a + bi → r(cos θ + i sin θ), θ in correct quadrant

skills.title: Multiply and divide in polar form
skills.io: two numbers in polar form → product/quotient (multiply moduli, add arguments)

skills.title: Raise to a power with De Moivre's Theorem
skills.io: zⁿ → rⁿ(cos nθ + i sin nθ) → a + bi

skills.title: Solve zⁿ = a (incl. nth roots of unity)
skills.io: zⁿ = a → n roots in polar and rectangular form

skills.title: Derive multiple-angle identities with De Moivre
skills.io: cos nθ or sin nθ → identity in powers of cos θ / sin θ

skills.title: Prove De Moivre's Theorem by induction
skills.io: (cos θ + i sin θ)ⁿ, n ∈ N → proof
skills.example: P(k) ⇒ P(k + 1) using sin(A + B), cos(A + B)

skills.title: Find the slope and equation of a tangent
skills.io: f(x) and a point → slope f′(a); tangent line

skills.title: Find where a curve has a given slope
skills.io: f(x) and slope m (or parallel line) → x (and point)

skills.title: Decide whether a function is increasing or decreasing at a point
skills.io: f(x) + x value → sign of f′(a)
skills.example: f = x² − 4x at x = 1 → f′ = −2 < 0, decreasing

skills.title: Find where a function is increasing/decreasing for all x or on intervals
skills.io: f(x) → intervals where f′ > 0 / f′ < 0

skills.title: Find and classify turning points
skills.io: f(x) → max/min points via f′ = 0 and f″

skills.title: Find a point of inflection
skills.io: f(x) → point where f″ = 0 and changes sign

skills.title: Sketch a curve using calculus
skills.io: f(x) → sketch with intercepts, turning points

skills.title: Sketch/match the graph of f′ from f
skills.io: graph of f → graph of f′ (and vice versa)
skills.example: turning points of f ↔ roots of f′

skills.title: Apply differentiation to rates of change
skills.io: quantity as a function of time → rate, velocity, acceleration at a time

skills.title: Solve connected rates of change
skills.io: formula linking variables + one known rate → unknown rate via chain rule
skills.example: V = 4/3 πr³, dr/dt = 0.5 at r = 3 → dV/dt = 18π

skills.title: Solve a max/min problem from a context
skills.io: verbal problem with a constraint → optimal value and the quantity achieving it

skills.title: Find the slope of a tangent to a circle by differentiation
skills.io: circle equation + point → slope dy/dx

skills.title: Apply derivatives of exp/log/trig functions to problems
skills.io: context with non-polynomial model → rate, max/min, tangent

skills.title: Differentiate from first principles
skills.io: linear or quadratic f(x) → f′(x) via lim [f(x + h) − f(x)]/h

skills.title: Differentiate a polynomial by rule
skills.io: linear, quadratic or cubic (any polynomial at HL) → f′(x)

skills.title: Find the second derivative
skills.io: f(x) → f″(x)

skills.title: Differentiate rational powers
skills.io: xⁿ, n ∈ Q (roots, reciprocals) → nxⁿ⁻¹

skills.title: Differentiate exponential functions
skills.io: e^(ax), aˣ → ae^(ax), aˣ ln a

skills.title: Differentiate logarithms
skills.io: ln x, ln f(x) → 1/x, f′(x)/f(x)

skills.title: Differentiate trig functions (radians)
skills.io: sin ax, cos ax, tan ax → derivative
skills.example: sin 4x → 4 cos 4x; tan x → sec² x

skills.title: Differentiate inverse trig functions
skills.io: sin⁻¹(x/a), tan⁻¹(x/a) → 1/√(a² − x²), a/(a² + x²)

skills.title: Apply the product rule
skills.io: u·v → u′v + uv′
skills.example: x² sin x → 2x sin x + x² cos x

skills.title: Apply the quotient rule
skills.io: u/v → (u′v − uv′)/v²

skills.title: Apply the chain rule
Differentiate a function needing several rules
skills.io: product/quotient of composites of exp, log, trig, powers → simplified derivative

skills.title: Show a derivative satisfies a given relation
skills.io: y = f(x) + relation in y, y′, y″ → verified identity

skills.title: Calculate percentages and percentage change
skills.io: quantities → %, % increase/decrease, original amount

skills.title: Calculate cost/selling price, discount, mark-up and margin
skills.io: prices → profit, mark-up (% of CP), margin (% of SP)

skills.title: Apply compound interest
skills.io: P, i, t → F = P(1 + i)ᵗ

skills.title: Apply reducing-balance depreciation
skills.io: P, i, t → F = P(1 − i)ᵗ

skills.title: Convert between annual and periodic rates (AER/APR)
skills.io: annual rate → equivalent monthly/weekly rate

skills.title: Find the rate or time in a compound interest problem
skills.io: P, F and t (or i) → i via roots, t via logs

skills.title: Calculate income tax, USC, PRSI and net pay
skills.io: gross pay, rates, bands, credits, deductions → gross tax, net tax, net pay

skills.title: Cost materials, labour and wastage
skills.io: job specification → total cost

skills.title: Change units (metric, imperial with factors, currency)
skills.io: quantity + conversion factor → converted quantity

skills.title: Calculate percentage error, tolerance and accumulated error
skills.io: true/estimated values or limits → % error, range of values

skills.title: Estimate, round and check order of magnitude
skills.io: calculation → estimate, rounded result, sense check

skills.title: Calculate an average rate of change over time
skills.io: change in quantity, time → rate

skills.title: Find the present value of a future sum
skills.io: F, i, t → P = F/(1 + i)ᵗ

skills.title: Find the future value of regular savings
skills.io: payment, i, number of payments → sum of a geometric series

skills.title: Find the present value of a series of payments (pension/annuity)
skills.io: payment, i, n → sum of present values

skills.title: Find the repayment on a loan/mortgage
Derive the mortgage repayment formula
skills.io: loan = sum of PVs of repayments → formula
skills.example: P = A/(1 + i) + … + A/(1 + i)ᵗ ⇒ formula

skills.title: Build or complete a loan amortisation schedule
skills.io: loan, rate, repayment → interest, capital repaid, balance each period

skills.title: Recognise a function and its domain/codomain/range
skills.io: mapping, rule or graph → is/isn't a function, domain, range

skills.title: Evaluate a function
skills.io: f(x) + input value or expression → output

skills.title: Form a composite function
skills.io: f(x), g(x) → f(g(x))

skills.title: Graph a linear function
skills.io: ax + b, domain → straight-line graph

skills.title: Graph a quadratic function
skills.io: ax² + bx + c, domain → parabola with roots, vertex, y-intercept

skills.title: Graph a cubic function
skills.io: ax³ + bx² + cx + d, domain → cubic curve

skills.title: Graph an exponential function
skills.io: a·bˣ (and eˣ at HL) → exponential curve

skills.title: Graph a logarithmic function
skills.io: logₐ x or ln x → log curve (reflection of aˣ in y = x)

skills.title: Solve equations approximately from graphs
skills.io: graphs of f and g → x where f(x) = 0, f(x) = k, f(x) = g(x)

skills.title: Interpret f(x) = g(x) as a comparison of functions
skills.io: two functions/graphs → intersections, regions where f > g
skills.example: 2ˣ vs x² → equal at x = 2, 4 and x ≈ −0.77

skills.title: Transform a graph
skills.io: f(x) and f(x) + k, f(x + h), kf(x) → transformed graph / equation

skills.title: Classify a function as injective, surjective, bijective
skills.io: function with domain and codomain → classification with reason

skills.title: Find the inverse of a bijective function
skills.io: y = f(x) → f⁻¹(x)

skills.title: Sketch the inverse from a graph
skills.io: graph of f → reflection in y = x

skills.title: Investigate the limit of a function
skills.io: f(x) near x = a (table/graph) → limiting value

skills.title: Find limits and explore continuity informally
skills.io: f(x), point a → lim f(x), continuous or not

skills.title: Fit an exponential model to data
skills.io: A·e^(kt) or a·bˣ + two data points → A, k (or a, b); prediction

skills.title: Construct √2 and √3 geometrically
skills.io: unit length → segments of length √2, √3

skills.title: Apply the laws of indices
skills.io: expression with powers → simplified power

skills.title: Evaluate negative and fractional indices
skills.io: a^(−p/q) → value or root form

skills.title: Write an expression as a power of a base
skills.io: expression with roots/fractions → base^k

skills.title: Solve an exponential equation with a common base
skills.io: aᶠ⁽ˣ⁾ = aᵍ⁽ˣ⁾ → x

skills.title: Solve an exponential equation reducible to a quadratic
skills.io: a^(2x) + b·aˣ + c = 0 → x

skills.title: Convert between log and index form (incl. e and ln)
skills.io: log or exponential statement → equivalent form / value

skills.title: Apply the laws of logs
skills.io: log expression → single log or value

skills.title: Change the base of a log
skills.io: logₐ x → log_b x / log_b a

skills.title: Solve a log equation
skills.io: equation in logs → x (reject invalid arguments)

skills.title: Solve aˣ = b by taking logs
skills.io: aˣ = b → x

skills.title: Prove a series identity by induction
skills.io: Σ identity → proof (base case, assume k, prove k + 1)

skills.title: Prove the finite geometric series sum by induction
skills.io: a + ar + … + arⁿ⁻¹ → proof

skills.title: Prove a divisibility result by induction
skills.io: statement "d divides f(n)" → proof

skills.title: Prove an inequality by induction
skills.io: inequality in n with starting value → proof

skills.title: Prove √2 is irrational by contradiction
skills.io: assumption √2 = p/q in lowest terms → contradiction

skills.title: Treat integration as reverse differentiation
skills.io: f(x) → F(x) + c with F′ = f

skills.title: Integrate powers, sums and constant multiples
skills.io: Σ kxᵃ, a ∈ Q → antiderivative + c
skills.example: ∫(3x² − 4x) dx → x³ − 2x² + c; ∫√x dx → ⅔x^(3/2) + c

skills.title: Integrate 1/x
skills.io: 1/x → ln|x| + c

skills.title: Integrate exponentials
skills.io: e^(ax), aˣ → (1/a)e^(ax) + c, aˣ/ln a + c

skills.title: Integrate sin ax and cos ax
skills.io: sin ax, cos ax → −(1/a)cos ax + c, (1/a)sin ax + c

skills.title: Integrate using a trig formula
skills.io: sin²x, cos²x, sin A cos B, … → antiderivative + c

skills.title: Evaluate a definite integral
skills.io: ∫ₐᵇ f(x) dx → number

skills.title: Find a function from its derivative and a point
skills.io: f′(x) + a value of f → f(x) with c found

skills.title: Find the area between a curve and the x-axis
skills.io: curve, limits (or roots) → area (parts below axis taken positive)

skills.title: Find the area between two curves
skills.io: two curves → area via ∫(top − bottom)

skills.title: Find the average value of a function on an interval
Continue and generalise a pattern
skills.io: terms or diagrams of a pattern → next terms; nth term in algebraic form

skills.title: Decide if a sequence is arithmetic, geometric or neither
skills.io: list of terms → type with reason (differences/ratios)

skills.title: Find the nth term of a quadratic sequence
skills.io: terms with constant second difference → Tₙ = an² + bn + c

skills.title: Find the nth term of an arithmetic sequence
skills.io: a, d (or terms) → Tₙ = a + (n − 1)d

skills.title: Find a and d from given terms or sums
skills.io: two facts about the sequence → a, d

skills.title: Sum n terms of an arithmetic series
Evaluate a series in Σ notation
skills.io: Σ expression → value

skills.title: Find the nth term of a geometric sequence
skills.io: a, r (or terms) → Tₙ = arⁿ⁻¹

skills.title: Sum n terms of a geometric series
skills.io: a, r, n → Sₙ = a(1 − rⁿ)/(1 − r)

skills.title: Find the number of terms needed in a geometric series
skills.io: a, r, target term/sum → n via logs

skills.title: Find limits of sequences by inspection and limit rules
skills.io: sequence → limit

skills.title: Sum an infinite geometric series
skills.io: a, r with |r| < 1 → S∞ = a/(1 − r)

skills.title: Derive S∞ as the limit of partial sums
skills.io: Sₙ formula → S∞ = a/(1 − r)

skills.title: Find values of x for which a geometric series converges
skills.io: series with r in terms of x → interval of x

skills.title: Write a recurring decimal as a fraction
skills.io: recurring decimal → fraction via S∞

skills.title: Verify and justify a formula from a number pattern
skills.io: pattern + proposed formula → checked/justified formula
